<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">BEN FRANKLIN FINANCIAL, INC. </font></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS </font></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">As of and for the Years Ended December 31, 2016 and <font class=" FactMarked">2015</font></font></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: center;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">(Dollars in thousands except per share data) </font></p>
<p style="border-bottom-color: #000000; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0.75pt; line-height: 12pt; margin: 0pt 0pt 2pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">NOTE <font class=" FactMarked">13</font>&nbsp;- FAIR VALUE MEASURES</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> (Continued)</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;"> </font></p>
</div>
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 24.45pt; margin-left: 4%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic;">(b) Certificates of deposit in other financial institutions. </font></p>
<p style="margin: 6pt 0pt 0pt 0pt; margin-left: 8%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Fair values for fixed rate certificates of deposit are estimated using a discounted cash flows calculation that applies interest rates currently being offered on certificates to a schedule of aggregated expected monthly maturities on time deposits resulting in a Level <font class=" FactMarked">2</font> classification. </font></p>
<p style="margin: 18pt 0pt 0pt 24.45pt; margin-left: 4%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic;">(c) Loans receivable, net </font></p>
<p style="margin: 6pt 0pt 0pt 48.95pt; margin-left: 8%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Fair values of loans receivable, net are estimated as follows: For variable rate loans that reprice frequently and with no significant change in credit risk, fair values are based on carrying values resulting in a Level <font class=" FactMarked">3</font> classification. Fair values for other loans are estimated using discounted cash flow analyses, using interest rates currently being offered for loans with similar terms to borrowers of similar credit quality resulting in a Level <font class=" FactMarked">3</font> classification. Impaired loans are valued at the lower of cost or fair value as described previously. The methods utilized to estimate the fair value of loans do not necessarily represent an exit price. </font></p>
<p style="margin: 18pt 0pt 0pt 24.45pt; margin-left: 4%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic;">(d) FHLB Stock </font></p>
<p style="margin: 6pt 0pt 0pt 48.95pt; margin-left: 8%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">It is not practical to determine the fair value of FHLB stock <font class=" FactMarked">due</font> to restrictions placed on its transferability. </font></p>
<p style="margin: 18pt 0pt 0pt 24.45pt; margin-left: 4%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic;">(e) Accrued Interest Receivable </font></p>
<p style="margin: 6pt 0pt 0pt 48.95pt; margin-left: 8%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The carrying amount of accrued interest receivable approximates its fair value and is classified as Level <font class=" FactMarked">2</font> for securities and Level <font class=" FactMarked">3</font> for loans. </font></p>
<p style="margin: 18pt 0pt 0pt 24.45pt; margin-left: 4%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic;">(f) Deposits </font></p>
<p style="margin: 6pt 0pt 0pt 48.95pt; margin-left: 8%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The fair values disclosed for demand deposits (e.g., interest and non-interest demand, savings, and certain types of money market accounts) and advances from borrowers for taxes and insurance are, by definition, equal to the amount payable on demand at the reporting date (i.e., their carrying amount) and are classified as Level</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><font class=" FactMarked">1</font>. The carrying amounts of variable rate certificates of deposit approximate their fair values at the reporting date are classified as a Level</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><font class=" FactMarked">2</font>. Fair values for fixed rate certificates of deposit are estimated using a discounted cash flows calculation that applies interest rates currently being offered on certificates to a schedule of aggregated expected monthly maturities on time deposits resulting in a Level <font class=" FactMarked">2</font> classification. </font></p>
<p style="margin: 18pt 0pt 0pt 24.45pt; margin-left: 4%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic;">(g)&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt;"><font><font class="com-color"><em class="selected">Federal Home Loan Bank Advances</em></font></font></font></p>
<p style="margin: 6pt 0pt 0pt 48.95pt; margin-left: 8%;"><font><font><font class="com-color"><font style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt;">The fair value of Federal Home Loan Bank advances is estimated using discounted cash flow analyses based on the current borrowing rates for similar types of borrowing arrangements resorting in a Level <font class=" FactMarked">2</font> classification.</font></font></font></font></p>
<p style="margin: 18pt 0pt 0pt 24.45pt; margin-left: 4%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic;">(h) Accrued Interest Payable </font></p>
<p style="margin: 6pt 0pt 0pt 48.95pt; margin-left: 8%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The carrying amount of accrued interest payable approximates its fair value and is classified as Level <font class=" FactMarked">2</font>.</font></p>
<p style="margin: 18pt 0pt 0pt 24.45pt; margin-left: 4%;"><font style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt;"><em>&nbsp;</em></font></p>
<div class="ExcludeValue">
<p style="border-bottom-color: #000000; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0.75pt; line-height: 12pt; margin: 0pt 0pt 2pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin: 12pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: center;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">(Continued) </font></p>

</td>

<p style="margin: 6pt 0pt 0pt; text-indent: 8%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Not Applicable </font></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 6pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border-collapse: collapse; margin-left: 0pt; width: 100%;" width="100%">

<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 9%;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Item</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">9A.</font></p>
</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="color: #000000;"><a style="text-decoration: none; color: #000000; cursor: default; outline: none;" href="#" name="22_ZPJ4USNOE8W8S04CWK80CKC8K04CGS" class="customBookmark"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Controls and Procedures </font></a></font></p>
</td>
</tr>

</table>
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 6pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border-collapse: collapse; margin-left: 0pt; width: 100%;" width="100%">

<tr>
<td style="vertical-align: middle; width: 8%;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 7%;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">(a)</font></p>
</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Evaluation of disclosure controls and procedures </font></p>
</td>
</tr>

</table>
<p style="margin: 12pt 0pt 0pt; text-indent: 8%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">An evaluation was performed under the supervision and with the participation of the Company&#8217;s management, including the President and Chief Executive Officer, and the Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, of the effectiveness of the design and operation of the Company&#8217;s disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in Rule</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">13a-15(e) promulgated under the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934, as amended) as of December</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">31, 2016. Based on that evaluation, the Company&#8217;s management, including the President and Chief Executive Officer and the Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, concluded that the Company&#8217;s disclosure controls and procedures were effective. </font></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 6pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border-collapse: collapse; margin-left: 0pt; width: 100%;" width="100%">

<tr>
<td style="vertical-align: middle; width: 8%;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 7%;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">(b)</font></p>
</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Management&#8217;s Report on Internal Control over Financial Reporting </font></p>
</td>
</tr>

</table>
<p style="text-indent: 0.5in; background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><br></p>
<p style="text-indent: 0.5in; background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">Management of the Company is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting. Our system of internal control is designed under the supervision of management, including our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, to provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of our financial reporting and the preparation of the Company&#8217;s financial statements for external reporting purposes in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (&#8220;GAAP&#8221;).</font></p>
<p style="background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-indent: 0.5in; background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">Our internal control over financial reporting includes policies and procedures that pertain to the maintenance of records that, in reasonable detail, accurately and fairly reflect transactions and dispositions of assets, provide reasonable assurances that transactions are recorded as necessary to permit preparation of financial statements in accordance with GAAP, and that receipts and expenditures are made only in accordance with the authorization of management and the Boards of Directors of the Company and provide reasonable assurance regarding prevention or timely detection of unauthorized acquisition, use, or disposition of the Company&#8217;s assets that could have a material effect on our financial statements.</font></p>
<p style="background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-indent: 0.5in; background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">Because of its inherent limitations, internal control over financial reporting may not prevent or detect misstatements. Projections of any evaluation of effectiveness to future periods are subject to the risk that the controls may become inadequate because of changes in conditions or that the degree of compliance with policies and procedures may deteriorate.</font></p>
<p style="background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-indent: 0.5in; background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">As of December 31, 2016, management assessed the effectiveness of the Company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting based upon the framework established in</font><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">&nbsp;2013 </font><i><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">Internal Control &#8212; Integrated Framework</font></i><i><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">&nbsp;</font></i><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO). Based upon its assessment, management believes that the Company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2016 is effective using these criteria.</font></p>
<p style="background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-indent: 0.5in; background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">This annual report does not include an attestation report of the Company&#8217;s registered public accounting firm regarding internal control over financial reporting.&nbsp;&nbsp;Management&#8217;s report was not subject to attestation by the Company&#8217;s registered public accounting firm pursuant to provisions of the Dodd-Frank Act that permit the Company to provide only management&#8217;s report in this annual report.</font></p>
<p style="text-indent: 0.5in; background: white; margin: 0in 0in 0.0001pt; font-size: 11pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><br></p>
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border-collapse: collapse; margin-left: 0pt; width: 100%;" width="100%">

<tr>
<td style="vertical-align: middle; width: 8%;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 7%;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">(c)</font></p>
</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;">
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Changes in internal controls </font></p>
</td>
</tr>

</table>
<p style="margin: 12pt 0pt 0pt; text-indent: 8%;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">There were no significant changes made in our internal control over financial reporting during the Company&#8217;s fourth quarter of the year ended December</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">31, 2016 that has materially affected, or is reasonably likely to materially affect, the Company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting. </font></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 18pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
